messages.body_plain:
The necessary revisions have been made in the sp package for spgrass6 to
work again, and sp_0.7-10 is now on CRAN. The matching spgrass6_0.1-4 is
on the R-spatial repository on Sourceforge. The code underlying the
GRASS-News article has been run without problems on this combination - not
that spgrass6_0.1-4 depends on sp >= 0.7-10.

The difficulties were caused by retrofiiting something we learned with the 
original GRASS package to sp, that using data frames for storing larger 
rasters is not efficient, and that an attribute list is a better 
alternative.

We are still looking for ways to get the interface working under 
Cygwin/Windows.

No, the GRASS package on CRAN is for GRASS 5, supports sites, and 
understands regions like 5.4. It works with all GRASS platforms.

The new spgrass6 package as described in GRASS-News only works with GRASS 
6, and is not as stable as the earlier version (yet). It will be 
loose-coupled, using file transfer or the GRASS plugin to GDAL for file 
transfer. This does not work (yet) with Cygwin, but will use the more 
advanced data structures of the sp package. It can already move vector 
data via shapefiles. It is available from the r-spatial sourceforge site, 
and if someone needs write access to CVS, please just contact me.
